item.title: Risky Bulletin: Moldova takes down 80+ public services after cyberattack
item.description: Hackers breached Moldova's government systems and stole data on about 750,000 citizens, and officials shut down 82 public digital services.

item.title: Jio Platforms closes India’s largest IPO at $3.2b
item.description: Jio Platforms closed India's largest IPO at $3.2 billion, receiving more than 1.38 crore applications.

item.title: Goldman Sachs Investment Banking Co-Head Sees ‘Repositioning’ Amid AI Boom
item.description: Kim Posnett of Goldman Sachs says weakness is emerging in the AI market as capital costs rise, though she is 'hugely bullish' on AI.

item.title: Synopsys joins NUS consortium for AI cooling research
item.description: Synopsys, which already offers electrothermal analysis tools, has joined an NUS consortium for AI cooling research.

item.title: Avoid area in Pasir Panjang over risk of flash floods: PUB
item.description: PUB advises avoiding Pasir Panjang over flash flood risk as heavy rain is expected in southern and western Singapore from 11.50am to 12.40pm.

item.title: AI worries expose dollar's hot-money problem
item.description: Foreign money chasing the AI boom could weaken the dollar's safe-haven role if the trade unwinds. Last week, when AI valuations came under pressure, haven flows favored the yen and Swiss franc over the dollar. Why it matters: Ties the AI trade to currency flows, which matters to anyone following markets and how the dollar behaves in a selloff.

item.title: PHP’s AI-found flaws expose a bigger gap: Who guards AI agents?
item.description: AI found decade-old flaws in PHP in two days, but patching at that speed would mean letting AI act on its own, with nobody guarding what it can touch. Why it matters: Raises the question of how AI agents are guarded, relevant to cybersecurity and CVE followers.

item.title: Correction or Manipulation? Measuring Epistemic Vigilance in LLM Agents Under User Pressure
item.description: Across seven LLMs, citing a source made five models readier to concede to users and four worse at telling correction from manipulation.

item.title: Curriculum-Driven Deep Reinforcement Learning for Autonomous Far-Range Rocket Landing
item.description: Paper proposes a curriculum-driven reinforcement learning framework that trains an agent to navigate long distances and land a reusable rocket softly.

item.title: CohortFlow: A Steerable Clinical Cohort Curation Agent with Localized Semantic Correction
item.description: CohortFlow is an agent that updates clinical cohort criteria from natural-language corrections, recomputing only affected parts and cutting correction latency.

item.title: Small countries need more cooperation with companies, NGOs in fractured world: Teo Chee Hean
item.description: Temasek chairman Teo Chee Hean said that as multilateral cooperation becomes frayed, polylateral arrangements can help global cooperation on AI guardrails.

item.title: Synopsys joins NUS-led group to test cooling for AI data centres
item.description: Synopsys has joined an NUS-led consortium to combine simulations with physical tests of cooling for AI data centres in tropical conditions.

item.title: KDDI and Others Use AI to Streamline Vulnerability Management Across Domestic and Overseas Supply Chains
item.description: KDDI, KDDI総合研究所 and ラック began offering an AI vulnerability management solution for domestic and overseas supply chains.

item.title: New programme to help start-ups test embodied AI on construction sites launched
item.description: Enterprise Singapore and BCA launched Startup CoLab EAI, with The GEAR by Kajima, to help start-ups test embodied AI systems on construction sites.

item.title: AI Agents Will Enter Finance Gradually: UOB Report
item.description: A UOB report says AI agents will enter finance gradually, starting with simple, rule-based tasks before handling complex decisions and autonomous capital movement.

item.title: Datavault AI stock plummets 50% after firm says it cannot withdraw bitcoin tied to $150 million deal

item.description: A research paper from researchers affiliated with Harvard University and Meta investigates how many people are deceived by AI-powered voice scam calls.

item.title: Sunday Cycling Lane in Seletar to more than double in length by early 2027
item.description: The Sunday cycling lane at Seletar Aerospace Park will increase from 4.6km to 11.2km by the first quarter of 2027.

item.title: Anthropic’s record IPO faces some big questions
item.description: Anthropic, which became an AI giant valued at US$1 trillion in five years, faces big questions over its record IPO.

item.title: Read with Snoopy and the Peanuts gang in NLB’s pop-up library in Plaza Singapura
item.description: NLB has a Snoopy pop-up library on Level 3 of Plaza Singapura, with themed spaces, running until Sep 19, 2027.

item.title: VCs will make billions on Anthropic’s IPO, but Amazon is set to make much (much) more
item.description: Amazon is likely the largest financial beneficiary of Anthropic's IPO, while venture firms like Menlo and Sequoia hold stakes under 5% each.

item.title: Anthropic said to pick JPMorgan to lead IPO’s US retail offering
item.description: Anthropic reportedly picked JPMorgan Chase to lead US retail share sales in its potentially record-setting IPO; Citigroup will coordinate the international offering.

item.title: Billionaire Ambani’s Jio to debut after record India IPO
item.description: Jio Platforms, the digital arm of Ambani's Reliance Industries, debuted on Oct 28 after a record US$3.2 billion India IPO. Its shares rose 21% in Mumbai, with demand exceeding 22 times the shares on offer. Why it matters: Shows Mukesh Ambani's push to turn Reliance from oil and chemicals into an 'everything company' spanning consumer and tech.

item.title: Chipmaker Onsemi in Talks to Buy Startup for About $1 Billion
item.description: Onsemi has reportedly discussed acquiring 16-year-old chip startup Ferric for close to $1 billion, a deal reflecting demand for AI chip energy-management technology.

item.title: Stocks to watch: Seatrium, MIT, Keppel Reit, Clint, UI Boustead Reit, Digital Core Reit, ST Engineering
item.description: Seatrium announced a floating power collaboration with Karpowership, while Mapletree Industrial Trust's second-quarter distribution per unit fell 6.6% to S$0.0297.

item.title: Meta rolls out Muse AI agent in Singapore amid global safety, retail pushback
item.description: Meta has launched Muse, a free consumer AI personal agent, in Singapore from Oct 28 via app stores and web. It can handle tasks like booking restaurant tables and plane tickets, with a weekly usage limit. Why it matters: Muse targets mainstream consumers, unlike other popular AI assistants that focus on office productivity and software development.

item.title: Anthropic Buys a Small Drug Startup as It Pushes Deeper Into Biotech
item.description: Anthropic said it acquired Mithril Medicine, a one-person startup developing treatments for two rare forms of muscular dystrophy, as it pushes into drug discovery.

item.title: Singapore sees continued respite from haze, with air quality remaining moderate
item.description: Air quality in Singapore is expected to remain in the moderate range on Wednesday, showing continued respite from haze.

item.title: Japan's GMO urges customers to shut down PCs amid ransomware threat
item.description: GMO Group told Onamae Desktop Cloud customers to disconnect and shut down PCs after a threatened ransomware attack following a breach.

item.description: Infisical, which lets companies use AI agents without sharing private credentials, raised a $40M Series B at a $600M valuation, led by Elad Gil.

item.title: Discord public server messages may be soon searchable on Google, but you can opt out
item.description: Discord will display summaries of public channels on Server Web Pages from November 16, and by mid-December messages may appear word-for-word in search results.

item.description: Bloomberg's Mark Gurman, citing sources, reports Apple has discussed charging $2,899 for a 14-inch touchscreen OLED MacBook Pro with an M5 Pro chip.

item.title: The best ways to tell if someone is using AI glasses
item.description: While it can be jarring to discover that your companion is using AI glasses, there are some steps you can take to recognize them ASAP.

item.description: SGTech's Gavin Chua and Gunasekharan Chellappan argue Singapore must invest in both AI, today's imperative, and quantum, which may be tomorrow's advantage.

item.title: Memory-Enforced GPU Sharing in Kubernetes with NVIDIA CUDA 13.4
item.description: CUDA 13.4 adds a transparent memory-enforced time-sharing mode for NVIDIA GPUs, letting Kubernetes workloads get exact or ranged memory amounts alongside compute sharing.

item.title: Fields Medal-winning UC Berkeley professor ends graded homework due to AI cheating
item.description: Fields Medal-winning UC Berkeley professor says grading AI answers wastes time and money, so he now uses only in-person exams.

item.title: Survival LLM: AI assistant and emergency library that runs on your own computer
item.description: Survival LLM is a free, open-source AI assistant that runs offline on your computer, answering emergency questions and citing its sources.
